how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackfathom-deeps-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:971:obj:0: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:971:details:0: As you might know, I collect lore. Old lore. Powerful lore. Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.
rows.quest:971:details:1: BThere are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in ⟦E2⟧. That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves. Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.
rows.quest:971:details:2: BSearch Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript. Do this, and I will not forget it. Not even after ... the end days.
rows.quest:971:completion:0: You found the manuscript! What a joyous day this is! Copies will be made and distributed, and the ancient knowledge of Lorgalis will finally be known to my brothers and sisters!
rows.quest:971:completion:1: BYour service to us is more than you know, ⟦1⟧. But I hope that this gift shows you the gratitude we extend to our allies.
rows.quest:1198:obj:0: Seek out Argent Guard Thaelrid in Blackfathom Deeps.
rows.quest:1198:details:0: Many rumors circulate these days about the union of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ and the naga in Blackfathom Deeps on the coasts of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1198:details:1: BMy role here with the Argent Dawn is to collect as much information as I can, so we know when and where help is needed.
rows.quest:1198:details:2: BIt has been weeks now since I sent a scout to check on the activity at Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Guard Thaelrid has not yet reported back.
rows.quest:1198:details:3: BMy other scouts are preoccupied with pressing matters.
rows.quest:1198:details:4: BSeek out and aid Thaelrid for me, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:1198:completion:0: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.
rows.quest:1199:obj:0: Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1199:details:0: Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods the members of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.
rows.quest:1199:details:1: BWe believe that the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ has allied with the naga and are amassing in Blackfathom Deeps on the coast of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1199:details:2: BWhatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.
rows.quest:1199:details:3: BWage war on the ⟦E3⟧ and bring back proof of your deeds. Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.
rows.quest:1199:completion:0: You are no doubt of brave and noble blood, ⟦3⟧. The Argent Dawn commends you for your efforts against evil.
rows.quest:1200:obj:0: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1200:details:0: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!
rows.quest:1200:details:1: BLong ago this site was a great temple of ⟦E5⟧. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.
rows.quest:1200:details:2: BAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.
rows.quest:1200:details:3: BThe Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.
rows.quest:1200:details:4: BSlay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in ⟦E4⟧, ⟦4⟧, please.
rows.quest:1200:completion:0: Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.
rows.quest:1200:completion:1: BIt seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him dead or missing.
rows.quest:1200:completion:2: BBut this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.
rows.quest:1200:completion:3: BBy the light! To sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!
rows.quest:1200:completion:4: BYou have done a great deed, ⟦5⟧. I salute you on behalf of the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:1275:obj:0: Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
rows.quest:1275:details:0: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:1275:details:1: BI fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. ⟦E7⟧ cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.
rows.quest:1275:details:2: BI wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of ⟦E2⟧, you will find both satyr and naga.
rows.quest:1275:completion:0: You have traveled far and undoubtedly faced great peril.
rows.quest:1275:completion:1: BYour actions have been selfless. 'Tis for the good of all ⟦E7⟧ that you help me with my research. I thank you, ⟦7⟧, for all that you have done.
rows.quest:1275:completion:2: BNow if you'll excuse me I have much work to do....
rows.quest:6561:obj:0: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:6561:details:0: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!
rows.quest:6561:details:1: BLong ago this site was a great temple of ⟦E5⟧. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.
rows.quest:6561:details:2: BAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.
rows.quest:6561:details:3: BThe Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.
rows.quest:6561:details:4: BSlay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in ⟦E8⟧, ⟦8⟧, please.
rows.quest:6561:completion:0: Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.
rows.quest:6561:completion:1: BFor some time they considered him dead or missing.
rows.quest:6561:completion:2: BBy ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:6561:completion:3: BEarthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!
rows.quest:6561:completion:4: BYou have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:6562:details:0: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in ⟦E2⟧. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through ⟦E9⟧. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, ⟦11⟧. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
rows.quest:6562:completion:0: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
rows.quest:6563:obj:0: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6563:details:0: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.
rows.quest:6563:details:1: BWill you help me, ⟦12⟧? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
rows.quest:6563:completion:0: Well done, ⟦13⟧. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...
rows.quest:6563:completion:1: BI can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
rows.quest:6564:obj:0: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6564:details:0: Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:
rows.quest:6564:details:1: B"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water ⟦E10⟧ are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.
rows.quest:6564:details:2: BBy controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
rows.quest:6564:completion:0: This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.
rows.quest:6564:completion:1: BNow we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
rows.quest:6565:obj:0: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6565:details:0: This Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, ⟦14⟧. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.
rows.quest:6565:details:1: BGo into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
rows.quest:6565:completion:0: Very good!! Thank you, ⟦15⟧. We may not have stopped the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.
rows.quest:6565:completion:1: BWho knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
rows.quest:6921:obj:0: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6921:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.
rows.quest:6921:details:1: B⟦16⟧, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. If I have it, I and the ⟦E11⟧ can maybe do something to stop them!
rows.quest:6921:completion:0: This is exactly what I need! A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from. Whatever the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.
rows.quest:6921:completion:1: BYou've done well here today; the ⟦E11⟧ looks upon you warmly for assisting us. You've also helped the ⟦E12⟧ as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
